variants.name: Full
variants.use: Intros, title cards, the front of a trailer.
variants.title: DaemonV12 sonic logo · full
variants.description: Two syllables. Beat 0: a clay pot whoops up to D and a palm booms the skin (the organic body). Two wooden knocks tick like a machine. Beat 1: a voice cries up to A and turns to glass while a gong bar and tuned bearings ring the digital edge out.

variants.name: Short
variants.use: Bumpers, app sounds, anywhere a second and a half is all you get.
variants.title: DaemonV12 sonic logo · short
variants.description: The same two syllables compressed to about a second and a half: pot and skin on the downbeat, two knocks, the cry to glass with a shorter ring.

variants.name: Quiet tail
variants.use: The last thing in a video: the same two syllables, hummed, into a long halo.
variants.title: DaemonV12 sonic logo · quiet tail
variants.description: The outro: the pot sags instead of whooping, a fingertip ghosts the skin, the knocks are soft, and the voice hums the same rise then falls away into a glass halo and a few last pings. For the end of a video.
